g.text: 3 px on the focused window's bottom edge, drawn by the
compositor. Draws out from the fill point, retracts to it.
62 sits at 62%. Each notch is a 60 ms tick: the band end
flashes and a 2 px underline enters under the changed digit.
Brightness lives on the screen's right edge, caps on the
focused top edge, media on the player's bottom edge.
Different edges, so nothing swaps or stacks.
Focus moves to the top-right window at 3.6 s: the volume
band slides across the gap in 140 ms. It does not re-appear.

svg.text: Phosphor · OSDs · value bands on the edge that concerns them
